video_title: KNICKS SWEEP THE CAVS 🧹 New York advances to their first NBA Finals in 27 YEARS 🔥 | NBA on ESPN

quotes.summary_phrase: New York Knicks reach NBA Finals after 27 years
quotes.excerpt: for the first time in 27 years, the New York Knicks are going to the NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: Let's go Knicks! It's over. Believe it, Knicks fans, for the first time in 27 years, the New York Knicks are going to the NBA Finals. The dream season continues and hopes of ending a decades-long championship drought are very much alive.
